fusions.name: Lifted Its Trick
fusions.desc: Darts to an enemy up to 6 tiles away, deals 10 damage and silences it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

fusions.name: Flipped Coin
fusions.desc: Flicks a coin at the first enemy in line up to 7 tiles away, dealing 4 damage with a 15% chance to confuse it for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nobody Saw a Thing
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Skimmed Off the Top
fusions.desc: Each critical hit you land pockets 6 mana. Once every 3 seconds.
